---------------------------- MODULE W4Od16m5p4t0 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Pharmacists, Quorum, Capacity
VARIABLES released, approvals, crashed

vars == <<released, approvals, crashed>>

Init ==
    /\ released = 0
    /\ approvals = {}
    /\ crashed = {}

Approve(p) ==
    /\ p \notin crashed
    /\ p \notin approvals
    /\ released < Capacity
    /\ approvals' = approvals \cup {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<released, crashed>>

Crash(p) ==
    /\ p \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {p}
    /\ approvals' = approvals \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED released

Recover(p) ==
    /\ p \in crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<released, approvals>>

Release ==
    /\ Cardinality(approvals) >= Quorum
    /\ released < Capacity
    /\ released' = released + 1
    /\ approvals' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED crashed

Restock ==
    /\ released = Capacity
    /\ released' = 0
    /\ approvals' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED crashed

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Pharmacists : Approve(p)
    \/ \E p \in Pharmacists : Crash(p)
    \/ \E p \in Pharmacists : Recover(p)
    \/ Release
    \/ Restock

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CapacityNeverExceeded == released <= Capacity
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Pharmacists = {p1, p2, p3}
    Quorum = 2
    Capacity = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapacityNeverExceeded
nl:
A hospital pharmacy runs an automated controlled-substance dispenser stocked with a fixed batch of unit doses. Every time the dispenser is asked to release one dose, a quorum of on-duty pharmacists must independently approve that specific request before it commits. There are three pharmacists on the roster; at least two must approve for a release to go through. Pharmacists register approvals one at a time for the pending request, and once enough have signed off the dose is released and the approval slate is cleared for the next request. Any single pharmacist may crash silently at any moment, dropping off shift without notice and losing their approval, and a crashed pharmacist can no longer approve; a pharmacist who dropped off may later come back on shift. When the batch is fully depleted the cabinet is restocked to a fresh batch of the same size and the approval slate resets. The dispenser must never release more doses than the current batch was stocked with, even if approvals, crashes, recoveries, and restocks interleave arbitrarily.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of doses released from the current batch never exceeds the stocked batch capacity.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od2m7p0t1 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Robots, NoOne
VARIABLES owner, inBay, claims

vars == <<owner, inBay, claims>>

Init ==
    /\ owner = NoOne
    /\ inBay = {}
    /\ claims = {}

Claim(r) ==
    /\ r \in Robots
    /\ r \notin claims
    /\ claims' = claims \cup {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, inBay>>

GrantCAS(r) ==
    /\ r \in claims
    /\ owner = NoOne
    /\ owner' = r
    /\ claims' = claims \ {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED inBay

DropStale(r) ==
    /\ r \in claims
    /\ owner # NoOne
    /\ claims' = claims \ {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, inBay>>

Enter(r) ==
    /\ owner = r
    /\ r \notin inBay
    /\ inBay' = inBay \cup {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, claims>>

Leave(r) ==
    /\ r \in inBay
    /\ owner = r
    /\ inBay' = inBay \ {r}
    /\ owner' = NoOne
    /\ UNCHANGED claims

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Claim(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : GrantCAS(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : DropStale(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Enter(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Leave(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

OnlyOwnerInBay == \A r \in inBay : owner = r
=========================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Robots = {rA, rB, rC}
    NoOne = none
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OnlyOwnerInBay
nl:
A fleet of warehouse robots shares a single narrow charging bay that only one robot may occupy at a time. Access is arbitrated through a compare-and-swap ownership register: the register either names the robot that currently owns the bay or is empty. A robot wanting the bay sends a claim message; because the radio link reorders messages freely, pending claims accumulate and may be granted in any order. Granting a claim is a compare-and-swap: it succeeds only when the register is observed empty, at which point it atomically names the claiming robot the owner; a claim that arrives when the register is already owned is simply discarded as stale. Only the robot named in the register may drive into the bay and begin charging, and when it leaves it clears the register back to empty and vacates the bay. The critical guarantee is that the bay is never occupied by any robot other than the current register owner.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every robot physically in the charging bay is the robot currently named by the ownership register.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od10m3p4t0 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Controllers, NoLeader, Capacity
VARIABLES leader, crashed, occupancy

vars == <<leader, crashed, occupancy>>

Init ==
    /\ leader = NoLeader
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ occupancy = 0

Elect(c) ==
    /\ leader = NoLeader
    /\ c \in Controllers
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ leader' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<crashed, occupancy>>

Crash(c) ==
    /\ c \in Controllers
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {c}
    /\ leader' = IF leader = c THEN NoLeader ELSE leader
    /\ UNCHANGED occupancy

Recover(c) ==
    /\ c \in crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, occupancy>>

Admit ==
    /\ leader # NoLeader
    /\ occupancy < Capacity
    /\ occupancy' = occupancy + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, crashed>>

Depart ==
    /\ occupancy > 0
    /\ occupancy' = occupancy - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, crashed>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Elect(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Crash(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Recover(c)
    \/ Admit
    \/ Depart

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

BlockNeverOverfilled == occupancy <= Capacity
=========================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Controllers = {c1, c2}
    NoLeader = novote
    Capacity = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT BlockNeverOverfilled
nl:
A subway line protects a shared single-track section with a block signalling system overseen by control computers, exactly one of which acts as the elected leader at any time. Only the current leader may signal a train to enter the protected section, and the section can safely hold at most a fixed number of trains at once. Controllers stand by to take over: when there is no leader, any healthy standby can be elected to become the new leader. A controller may crash silently at any moment; if the crashed controller happened to be the leader, the leadership falls vacant and a failover election is needed before any further train may be admitted. A crashed controller can later be brought back online as a healthy standby. Trains admitted by the leader occupy the section and eventually depart the far end, freeing space. No matter how elections, crashes, recoveries, admissions, and departures interleave, the number of trains inside the protected section must never exceed its rated capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of trains occupying the protected block section never exceeds its rated capacity.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od15m9p6t3 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Participants, MaxEpoch
VARIABLES epoch, members, holders

vars == <<epoch, members, holders>>

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ members = Participants
    /\ holders = {}

Submit(p) ==
    /\ p \in members
    /\ p \notin holders
    /\ holders' = holders \cup {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, members>>

Release(p) ==
    /\ p \in holders
    /\ holders' = holders \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, members>>

Reconfigure(newmembers) ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ members' = newmembers
    /\ holders' = holders \cap newmembers
    /\ UNCHANGED <<>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Participants : Submit(p)
    \/ \E p \in Participants : Release(p)
    \/ \E nm \in (SUBSET Participants \ {{}}) : Reconfigure(nm)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

HoldersAreCurrentMembers == holders \subseteq members
=========================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Participants = {mmA, mmB, mmC}
    MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT HoldersAreCurrentMembers
nl:
A stock exchange holds an opening auction whose set of authorized market makers is fixed by a numbered configuration epoch. Only a participant listed as a current member of the active epoch may place a live order into the auction book. Periodically the exchange performs an epoch-numbered reconfiguration: it advances the epoch number and installs a new authorized membership set, which may add or drop participants. When a participant is dropped by a reconfiguration, any live order it was holding is immediately cancelled so that a dropped, now-stale participant retains no standing in the book. Participants are never assumed to have failed; a slow participant may simply take a long time before it chooses to place or release an order, but it does not crash. A participant may also voluntarily release its live order at any time. Across any interleaving of order placement, releases, and reconfigurations, the auction book must never contain a live order from a participant that is not a current authorized member.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every participant holding a live order in the auction book is a current authorized member of the active configuration epoch.

spec_text:
--------------------------- MODULE W4Od4m2p0t1 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Cars, Stations, NoCar
VARIABLES phase, proposed, votes, washing

vars == <<phase, proposed, votes, washing>>

Init ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ proposed = NoCar
    /\ votes = [s \in Stations |-> "none"]
    /\ washing = {}

Propose(c) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ washing = {}
    /\ c \in Cars
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ proposed' = c
    /\ votes' = [s \in Stations |-> "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED washing

Vote(s, v) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ votes[s] = "none"
    /\ v \in {"yes", "no"}
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![s] = v]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, proposed, washing>>

Commit ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \A s \in Stations : votes[s] = "yes"
    /\ washing' = {proposed}
    /\ phase' = "committed"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<proposed, votes>>

Abort ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \E s \in Stations : votes[s] = "no"
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ proposed' = NoCar
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, washing>>

Exit ==
    /\ phase = "committed"
    /\ washing' = {}
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ proposed' = NoCar
    /\ UNCHANGED votes

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Propose(c)
    \/ \E s \in Stations : \E v \in {"yes", "no"} : Vote(s, v)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort
    \/ Exit

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

AtMostOneCarWashing == washing = {} \/ \E c \in Cars : washing = {c}
=========================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Cars = {carA, carB}
    Stations = {presoak, rinse}
    NoCar = nocar
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT AtMostOneCarWashing
nl:
An automatic car-wash has two feeder conveyors that merge into a single wash bay containing one spray gantry that can service only one car at a time. Before a car is allowed to move from a feeder into the bay, a coordinator runs a two-phase commit across the wash stations (pre-soak, brush, rinse): it proposes the specific car, each station votes yes or no on whether it is ready, and because the internal bus reorders messages the votes may arrive in any order. Only if every station votes yes does the coordinator commit and admit the proposed car into the bay; if any station votes no the round is aborted and no car enters. A car may only be proposed when the bay is currently empty. When the washing car finishes it exits the bay, leaving it empty and ready for the next two-phase round. Throughout every possible interleaving and reordering of votes, the wash bay must never hold more than one car simultaneously.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At most one car occupies the shared wash bay at any time.

spec_text:
-------------------------- MODULE W4Od11m9p3t1 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Jobs, Slots, MaxEpoch, Free, NoneSlot
VARIABLES owner, claim, pending, epoch

vars == <<owner, claim, pending, epoch>>

Init ==
    /\ owner = [s \in Slots |-> Free]
    /\ claim = [j \in Jobs |-> NoneSlot]
    /\ pending = {}
    /\ epoch = 0

Request(j) ==
    /\ j \notin pending
    /\ claim[j] = NoneSlot
    /\ pending' = pending \cup {j}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, claim, epoch>>

Grant(j, s) ==
    /\ j \in pending
    /\ owner[s] = Free
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = j]
    /\ claim' = [claim EXCEPT ![j] = s]
    /\ pending' = pending \ {j}
    /\ UNCHANGED epoch

Release(j) ==
    /\ claim[j] # NoneSlot
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![claim[j]] = Free]
    /\ claim' = [claim EXCEPT ![j] = NoneSlot]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, epoch>>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ owner' = [s \in Slots |-> Free]
    /\ claim' = [j \in Jobs |-> NoneSlot]
    /\ pending' = {}

Next ==
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : Request(j)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : \E s \in Slots : Grant(j, s)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : Release(j)
    \/ Reconfigure

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

ClaimMatchesOwner == \A j \in Jobs : claim[j] = NoneSlot \/ owner[claim[j]] = j
=========================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Jobs = {j1, j2}
    Slots = {s1, s2}
    MaxEpoch = 2
    Free = free
    NoneSlot = noslot
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT ClaimMatchesOwner
nl:
A print shop runs a job spooler that assigns incoming print jobs to physical printer slots, where each slot can drive only one job. Jobs submit requests to be spooled, and because the office network reorders traffic the spooler may grant queued requests in any order and pair a waiting job with any currently free slot. Granting records two things atomically: the slot's owner becomes that job, and the job remembers which slot it was given. A job may later release its slot, freeing it. From time to time the shop performs an epoch-numbered reconfiguration of the printer pool: it advances the epoch counter and reprovisions the hardware, which cancels every current allocation so that all slots return to free and no job holds a slot. The essential correctness condition is that the ownership records never disagree: whenever a job believes it holds a particular slot, that slot's owner record must name exactly that job, so a single slot is never handed to two different jobs.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No printer slot is ever allocated to two different jobs at once; every job's held-slot record agrees with that slot's owner.

spec_text:
--------------------------- MODULE W4Od15m1p0t5 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS N
VARIABLES token, inEngine, adminActive

vars == <<token, inEngine, adminActive>>

Nodes == 0 .. (N - 1)

Init ==
    /\ token = 0
    /\ inEngine = {}
    /\ adminActive = FALSE

PassToken ==
    /\ token \notin inEngine
    /\ token' = (token + 1) % N
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inEngine, adminActive>>

Enter(n) ==
    /\ n = token
    /\ adminActive = FALSE
    /\ inEngine = {}
    /\ inEngine' = {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, adminActive>>

Exit(n) ==
    /\ n \in inEngine
    /\ inEngine' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, adminActive>>

AdminSeize ==
    /\ adminActive = FALSE
    /\ adminActive' = TRUE
    /\ inEngine' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED token

AdminRelease ==
    /\ adminActive = TRUE
    /\ adminActive' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, inEngine>>

Next ==
    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Enter(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Exit(n)
    \/ AdminSeize
    \/ AdminRelease

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

ExclusiveEngineAccess ==
    /\ inEngine \subseteq {token}
    /\ (adminActive => inEngine = {})
=========================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    N = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT ExclusiveEngineAccess
nl:
A stock exchange serialises access to its opening-auction matching engine using a token ring over the member gateway nodes arranged in a fixed cycle. The single token circulates around the ring from each node to its successor, and only the node currently holding the token may enter the matching engine to submit its batch. A node enters the engine only when it holds the token and no one else is inside, and it exits when done. The exchange operator has a privileged admin override: at any moment the operator may seize the engine for emergency maintenance, which immediately ejects any member node that was inside and takes exclusive control; the operator later releases the override. While the operator override is active, no member node may be inside the engine. Across all interleavings of token passing, node entries and exits, and operator seizures and releases, the matching engine is never used by more than one party, and any member inside must be the current token holder.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At any time the matching engine is accessed only by the current token holder or the operator override, never by both and never by a non-holder member.

spec_text:
--------------------------- MODULE W4Od14m8p3t5 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Drones, Cells, Free
VARIABLES sectorLock, cellOwner

vars == <<sectorLock, cellOwner>>

Init ==
    /\ sectorLock = Free
    /\ cellOwner = [c \in Cells |-> Free]

AcquireSector(d) ==
    /\ sectorLock = Free
    /\ sectorLock' = d
    /\ UNCHANGED cellOwner

AcquireCell(d, c) ==
    /\ sectorLock = d
    /\ cellOwner[c] = Free
    /\ cellOwner' = [cellOwner EXCEPT ![c] = d]
    /\ UNCHANGED sectorLock

ReleaseCell(d, c) ==
    /\ cellOwner[c] = d
    /\ cellOwner' = [cellOwner EXCEPT ![c] = Free]
    /\ UNCHANGED sectorLock

ReleaseSector(d) ==
    /\ sectorLock = d
    /\ \A c \in Cells : cellOwner[c] # d
    /\ sectorLock' = Free
    /\ UNCHANGED cellOwner

AdminOverride(d, c) ==
    /\ sectorLock' = d
    /\ cellOwner' = [k \in Cells |-> IF k = c THEN d ELSE Free]

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Drones : AcquireSector(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : \E c \in Cells : AcquireCell(d, c)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : \E c \in Cells : ReleaseCell(d, c)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : ReleaseSector(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : \E c \in Cells : AdminOverride(d, c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

FineOwnerHoldsCoarse ==
    \A c \in Cells : cellOwner[c] = Free \/ sectorLock = cellOwner[c]
=========================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Drones = {d1, d2}
    Cells = {cA, cB}
    Free = free
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT FineOwnerHoldsCoarse
nl:
A wildfire surveillance drone swarm coordinates airspace over a burn zone using hierarchical locks: a coarse lock on a whole sector, and fine locks on individual observation cells inside that sector. To claim a cell a drone must first hold the coarse lock on the enclosing sector; the sector lock is exclusive, so only one drone holds it at a time. Having taken the sector, a drone may claim any free cell within it, and it releases cells and finally the sector when finished (the sector can only be released once the drone holds none of its cells). Mission control has a privileged admin override: it may seize an entire sector for a single designated drone at once, clearing every other cell allocation in that sector and granting the sector lock and one cell to the chosen drone. The governing safety condition is hierarchical consistency: any drone that owns a fine observation cell must also currently hold the coarse lock on that cell's sector, which guarantees no cell is ever allocated to a drone that does not exclusively hold the sector.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every observation cell that is allocated is owned by the drone that currently holds the exclusive coarse lock on that cell's sector.

spec_text:
--------------------------- MODULE W4Od15m5p0t5 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Nodes, Quorum, NoNode
VARIABLES pending, votes, inEngine, adminActive

vars == <<pending, votes, inEngine, adminActive>>

Init ==
    /\ pending = NoNode
    /\ votes = {}
    /\ inEngine = {}
    /\ adminActive = FALSE

Request(n) ==
    /\ pending = NoNode
    /\ inEngine = {}
    /\ pending' = n
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inEngine, adminActive>>

Vote(v) ==
    /\ pending # NoNode
    /\ v \notin votes
    /\ votes' = votes \cup {v}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, inEngine, adminActive>>

Grant ==
    /\ pending # NoNode
    /\ Cardinality(votes) >= Quorum
    /\ adminActive = FALSE
    /\ inEngine = {}
    /\ inEngine' = {pending}
    /\ pending' = NoNode
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED adminActive

Release(n) ==
    /\ n \in inEngine
    /\ inEngine' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, votes, adminActive>>

AdminSeize ==
    /\ adminActive = FALSE
    /\ adminActive' = TRUE
    /\ inEngine' = {}
    /\ pending' = NoNode
    /\ votes' = {}

AdminRelease ==
    /\ adminActive = TRUE
    /\ adminActive' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, votes, inEngine>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Request(n)
    \/ \E v \in Nodes : Vote(v)
    \/ Grant
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Release(n)
    \/ AdminSeize
    \/ AdminRelease

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

EngineMutualExclusion ==
    /\ (inEngine = {} \/ \E n \in Nodes : inEngine = {n})
    /\ (adminActive => inEngine = {})
=========================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Nodes = {g1, g2, g3}
    Quorum = 2
    NoNode = nonode
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT EngineMutualExclusion
nl:
A stock exchange guards exclusive access to its opening-auction matching engine by quorum voting among its gateway nodes. When a node wants to run its batch through the engine it becomes the pending requester, and the other nodes cast votes approving that requester. Access is granted only when a quorum of votes has been collected, the engine is currently empty, and no operator override is in force; at that point the requester is admitted as the sole occupant of the engine and the vote slate is cleared. The occupant later releases the engine when finished. The exchange operator holds a privileged admin override: it may seize the engine at any time, which immediately ejects any node occupant and blocks new grants while the override is active, and it later releases the override. While the operator override is active no node may occupy the engine. Under every interleaving of requests, votes, grants, releases, and operator seizures, the matching engine is occupied by at most one node at a time and never by a node while the operator override is active.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The matching engine is occupied by at most one gateway node at a time, and by none while the operator override is active.

spec_text:
--------------------------- MODULE W4Od17m6p0t1 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Controllers, NoOne, Lease, MaxTime
VARIABLES holder, expiry, clock, commanding

vars == <<holder, expiry, clock, commanding>>

Init ==
    /\ holder = NoOne
    /\ expiry = 0
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ commanding = {}

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxTime
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ commanding' = IF clock + 1 >= expiry THEN {} ELSE commanding
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, expiry>>

Acquire(n) ==
    /\ holder = NoOne \/ clock >= expiry
    /\ commanding = {}
    /\ holder' = n
    /\ expiry' = clock + Lease
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, commanding>>

Renew(n) ==
    /\ holder = n
    /\ clock < expiry
    /\ expiry' = clock + Lease
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, clock, commanding>>

Command(n) ==
    /\ holder = n
    /\ clock < expiry
    /\ n \notin commanding
    /\ commanding' = {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, expiry, clock>>

Stop(n) ==
    /\ n \in commanding
    /\ commanding' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, expiry, clock>>

Next ==
    \/ Tick
    \/ \E n \in Controllers : Acquire(n)
    \/ \E n \in Controllers : Renew(n)
    \/ \E n \in Controllers : Command(n)
    \/ \E n \in Controllers : Stop(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

LeasedCommandOnly ==
    /\ commanding \subseteq {holder}
    /\ (commanding # {} => clock < expiry)
=========================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Controllers = {r1, r2}
    NoOne = noone
    Lease = 2
    MaxTime = 4
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT LeasedCommandOnly
nl:
An airport baggage-handling system lets router controllers take turns driving a shared high-speed diverter that can only be commanded by one controller at a time. Exclusive control is granted through a time-bounded lease: a controller acquires the diverter lease, which is stamped with an expiry a fixed number of clock ticks in the future, and only the current holder of an unexpired lease may actually command the diverter. A discrete clock advances tick by tick. Because the control-plane bus reorders messages, acquire, renew, use, and stop notifications may be processed in any order, and the guards must reject any stale message. A holder may renew its lease before it expires to extend the deadline. When a lease reaches its expiry the clock tick that crosses the deadline automatically detaches the expired holder from the diverter, so the diverter is freed for a fresh acquisition. Across every interleaving, the diverter is commanded only by the current holder of a currently-valid lease.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Any controller actively commanding the diverter is the holder of a lease that has not yet expired.

spec_text:
--------------------------- MODULE W4Od19m1p4t4 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS N, MaxCap
VARIABLES token, holds, capacity

vars == <<token, holds, capacity>>

Init ==
    /\ token = 0
    /\ holds = 0
    /\ capacity = MaxCap

PassToken ==
    /\ token' = (token + 1) % N
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holds, capacity>>

AddHold ==
    /\ holds < capacity
    /\ holds' = holds + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, capacity>>

CancelHold ==
    /\ holds > 0
    /\ holds' = holds - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, capacity>>

SetCapacity(c) ==
    /\ capacity' = c
    /\ holds' = IF c < holds THEN c ELSE holds
    /\ UNCHANGED token

Next ==
    \/ PassToken
    \/ AddHold
    \/ CancelHold
    \/ \E c \in 1 .. MaxCap : SetCapacity(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

HoldsWithinCapacity == holds <= capacity
=========================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    N = 2
    MaxCap = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT HoldsWithinCapacity
nl:
A library reservation system lets branch terminals place holds on a shared reservation shelf that has a limited number of hold slots. The terminals are arranged in a token ring, and a single circulating token grants the exclusive right to modify the shelf: only the terminal currently holding the token may add a new hold, and the token is passed around the ring from each terminal to its successor. A hold may be added whenever the shelf is not full, and existing holds may be cancelled, freeing a slot. The shelf's slot capacity is reconfigurable at runtime: staff may raise or lower it. When capacity is lowered below the number of holds currently on the shelf, the excess holds at the bottom are automatically bumped off so that the number of holds is brought down to the new capacity. Under every interleaving of token passing, hold additions, cancellations, and capacity changes, the number of holds on the shelf never exceeds the shelf's current capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of active holds on the reservation shelf never exceeds the shelf's current runtime capacity.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od14m6p4t0 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Drones, Cap, Lease, MaxTime
VARIABLES occupants, leaseExp, clock, crashed

vars == <<occupants, leaseExp, clock, crashed>>

Init ==
    /\ occupants = {}
    /\ leaseExp = [d \in Drones |-> 0]
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ crashed = {}

Join(d) ==
    /\ d \notin occupants
    /\ d \notin crashed
    /\ Cardinality(occupants) < Cap
    /\ occupants' = occupants \cup {d}
    /\ leaseExp' = [leaseExp EXCEPT ![d] = clock + Lease]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, crashed>>

Renew(d) ==
    /\ d \in occupants
    /\ d \notin crashed
    /\ clock < leaseExp[d]
    /\ leaseExp' = [leaseExp EXCEPT ![d] = clock + Lease]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupants, clock, crashed>>

Crash(d) ==
    /\ d \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupants, leaseExp, clock>>

Recover(d) ==
    /\ d \in crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \ {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupants, leaseExp, clock>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxTime
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ occupants' = {d \in occupants : leaseExp[d] > clock + 1}
    /\ leaseExp' = [d \in Drones |-> IF leaseExp[d] > clock + 1 THEN leaseExp[d] ELSE 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED crashed

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Join(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Renew(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Crash(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Recover(d)
    \/ Tick

cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Drones = {a1, a2, a3}
    Cap = 2
    Lease = 2
    MaxTime = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT AirspaceWithinCap
nl:
A wildfire surveillance drone swarm shares a restricted patch of airspace over the fire that can safely hold only a bounded number of drones at once. A drone joins the airspace by taking out a time-limited occupancy lease stamped with an expiry a fixed number of clock ticks ahead; it may join only while the airspace is below its capacity limit. A drone renews its lease before expiry to stay, and a discrete mission clock advances tick by tick. When a lease reaches expiry, the crossing tick automatically evicts that drone from the airspace, freeing room. Any single drone may crash silently at any time: a crashed drone stops renewing but its lease keeps its slot occupied until it expires and is then reclaimed, so the system self-heals without ever being told of the crash. A crashed drone may later be recovered and rejoin. No matter how joins, renewals, ticks, crashes, and recoveries interleave, the number of drones occupying the airspace never exceeds its capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of drones occupying the restricted airspace never exceeds the airspace capacity limit.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od15m6p2t4 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Makers, Total, MaxCap, MaxTime
VARIABLES pool, held, clock, capacity

vars == <<pool, held, clock, capacity>>

RECURSIVE SumF(_)
SumF(S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN held[x] + SumF(S \ {x})

SumHeld == SumF(Makers)

Init ==
    /\ pool = Total
    /\ held = [m \in Makers |-> 0]
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ capacity = MaxCap

Lease(m) ==
    /\ pool > 0
    /\ held[m] < capacity
    /\ pool' = pool - 1
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![m] = held[m] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, capacity>>

ReturnEarly(m) ==
    /\ held[m] > 0
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![m] = held[m] - 1]
    /\ pool' = pool + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, capacity>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxTime
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ pool' = pool + SumHeld
    /\ held' = [m \in Makers |-> 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED capacity

SetCapacity(c) ==
    /\ capacity' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, held, clock>>

Next ==
    \/ \E m \in Makers : Lease(m)
    \/ \E m \in Makers : ReturnEarly(m)
    \/ Tick
    \/ \E c \in 0 .. MaxCap : SetCapacity(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

SharesConserved == pool + SumHeld = Total
=========================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Makers = {mm1, mm2}
    Total = 2
    MaxCap = 2
    MaxTime = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT SharesConserved
nl:
A stock exchange runs an opening auction in which a fixed total number of tradable share units is split between a central pool and the inventory leased out to market makers. A market maker leases share units from the central pool one at a time, moving a unit from the pool into its own inventory, but it may only lease while its inventory is below its current per-maker lease capacity. A maker may voluntarily return a unit early, moving it back from its inventory to the pool. Leases are time bounded: a session clock ticks forward, and each tick expires all outstanding leases, returning every leased unit from every maker's inventory back to the central pool at once. The per-maker lease capacity is reconfigurable at runtime and may be raised or lowered by the exchange, which only changes how much a maker may lease going forward and never moves any units. Because every operation only moves units between the pool and inventories, the grand total of share units in the system is invariant: units are neither created nor destroyed.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The pool balance plus the sum of all makers' leased inventory always equals the fixed total number of share units.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od3m2p6t0 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Banks
VARIABLES phase, votes, authorized, crashed

vars == <<phase, votes, authorized, crashed>>

Init ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ votes = [b \in Banks |-> "none"]
    /\ authorized = Banks
    /\ crashed = {}

StartBatch ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ votes' = [b \in Banks |-> "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<authorized, crashed>>

CastVote(b, v) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ b \in authorized
    /\ b \notin crashed
    /\ votes[b] = "none"
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![b] = v]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, authorized, crashed>>

Authorize(b) ==
    /\ b \notin authorized
    /\ authorized' = authorized \cup {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, votes, crashed>>

Deauthorize(b) ==
    /\ b \in authorized
    /\ authorized' = authorized \ {b}
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![b] = "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, crashed>>

Crash(b) ==
    /\ b \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, votes, authorized>>

Commit ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \A b \in authorized : (b \in crashed \/ votes[b] = "yes")
    /\ phase' = "committed"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, authorized, crashed>>

Abort ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \E b \in authorized : votes[b] = "no"
    /\ phase' = "aborted"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, authorized, crashed>>

Reset ==
    /\ phase \in {"committed", "aborted"}
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ votes' = [b \in Banks |-> "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<authorized, crashed>>

Next ==
    \/ StartBatch
    \/ \E b \in Banks : \E v \in {"yes", "no"} : CastVote(b, v)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Authorize(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Deauthorize(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Crash(b)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort
    \/ Reset

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

VotesOnlyFromAuthorized ==
    {b \in Banks : votes[b] # "none"} \subseteq authorized
=========================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Banks = {bk1, bk2}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT VotesOnlyFromAuthorized
nl:
A clearing house settles an interbank batch using two-phase commit across the member banks. Each settlement round, the coordinator opens voting and every currently authorized, non-crashed member bank casts a yes or no vote on whether it can settle. The round commits only if every authorized member that has not crashed has voted yes, and aborts if any authorized member votes no; afterwards the round resets for the next batch. Membership is dynamic: the clearing house may authorize a new bank or de-authorize an existing one, and de-authorizing a bank immediately clears any vote it had cast so that a removed, now-stale bank retains no standing in the round. Any single bank may crash silently at any moment and simply stops voting, without notifying anyone. The core integrity requirement is that no unauthorized or stale bank ever has a vote counted in the round: every bank that has a recorded vote must currently be an authorized member.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every bank whose vote is recorded in the current round is a currently authorized member.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od11m0p5t5 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Jobs, Mod
VARIABLES version, available, consumed, attempt

vars == <<version, available, consumed, attempt>>

NoAtt == Mod

Init ==
    /\ version = 0
    /\ available = Jobs
    /\ consumed = {}
    /\ attempt = [j \in Jobs |-> NoAtt]

Edit ==
    /\ version' = (version + 1) % Mod
    /\ UNCHANGED <<available, consumed, attempt>>

BeginPrint(j) ==
    /\ j \in available
    /\ attempt' = [attempt EXCEPT ![j] = version]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, available, consumed>>

CommitPrint(j) ==
    /\ j \in available
    /\ attempt[j] = version
    /\ available' = available \ {j}
    /\ consumed' = consumed \cup {j}
    /\ version' = (version + 1) % Mod
    /\ attempt' = [attempt EXCEPT ![j] = NoAtt]

Retry(j) ==
    /\ attempt[j] # NoAtt
    /\ attempt[j] # version
    /\ attempt' = [attempt EXCEPT ![j] = NoAtt]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, available, consumed>>

AdminForcePrint(j) ==
    /\ j \in available
    /\ available' = available \ {j}
    /\ consumed' = consumed \cup {j}
    /\ attempt' = [attempt EXCEPT ![j] = NoAtt]
    /\ UNCHANGED version

AdminResetVersion ==
    /\ version' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED <<available, consumed, attempt>>

Next ==
    \/ Edit
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : BeginPrint(j)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : CommitPrint(j)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : Retry(j)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : AdminForcePrint(j)
    \/ AdminResetVersion

TokensPartitioned ==
    /\ available \cap consumed = {}
    /\ available \cup consumed = Jobs

cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Jobs = {j1, j2}
    Mod = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT TokensPartitioned
nl:
A print shop spooler must guarantee that each physical print of a job is an irreversible one-shot action: once a job has actually been printed it can never be printed again. Every job carries a single-use print token that starts available and, once the job is printed, moves to consumed. Concurrency is handled with optimistic locking over a spool version counter that cycles as edits happen: to print a job a worker first reads the current version, and the commit succeeds only if the version is still unchanged, moving the job's token from available to consumed and bumping the version; if the version has moved on, the attempt is stale and the worker must retry. Ordinary edits advance the version at any time. The shop manager holds a privileged admin override that can force a print through despite a version conflict, skipping the optimistic check, but even the override still requires the job's token to be available, so it can never reprint an already-printed job. The manager may also reset the version counter. No matter how edits, attempts, retries, commits, and overrides interleave, each job's print token is either available or consumed but never both, and every job has exactly one token.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The available and consumed print-token sets are always disjoint and together cover every job, so no job is ever printed more than once.

    Depts = {anes, surg}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleConfirmation
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler books a surgical slot only after a two-phase commit across the responsible departments (for example anesthesia and surgery). Each booking round the coordinator opens collection, and every currently credentialed department confirms its readiness for the pending slot. The round books the slot only when all currently credentialed departments have confirmed; the booking then closes and the scheduler returns to idle. Credentials are managed dynamically: a department may be credentialed or have its credential revoked, and revoking a department immediately withdraws any confirmation it had already given so that a revoked, now-stale department has no standing in the round. The hospital's chief of staff holds a privileged admin override that can force the slot booked immediately without waiting for confirmations, used in emergencies. The safety-critical requirement is that no unauthorized or stale department is ever recorded as having confirmed the current round: every department in the confirmation set must be currently credentialed.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every department recorded as having confirmed the current booking round is a currently credentialed department.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od3m8p3t0 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Banks, Free
VARIABLES acctLock, slotOwner, crashed

Slots == 0 .. 3
Accounts == 0 .. 1
Parent(s) == s \div 2

vars == <<acctLock, slotOwner, crashed>>

Init ==
    /\ acctLock = [a \in Accounts |-> Free]
    /\ slotOwner = [s \in Slots |-> Free]
    /\ crashed = {}

AcquireAcct(b, a) ==
    /\ b \notin crashed
    /\ acctLock[a] = Free
    /\ acctLock' = [acctLock EXCEPT ![a] = b]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slotOwner, crashed>>

AcquireSlot(b, s) ==
    /\ b \notin crashed
    /\ acctLock[Parent(s)] = b
    /\ slotOwner[s] = Free
    /\ slotOwner' = [slotOwner EXCEPT ![s] = b]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<acctLock, crashed>>

ReleaseSlot(b, s) ==
    /\ slotOwner[s] = b
    /\ slotOwner' = [slotOwner EXCEPT ![s] = Free]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<acctLock, crashed>>

ReleaseAcct(b, a) ==
    /\ acctLock[a] = b
    /\ \A s \in Slots : Parent(s) = a => slotOwner[s] # b
    /\ acctLock' = [acctLock EXCEPT ![a] = Free]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slotOwner, crashed>>

Crash(b) ==
    /\ b \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<acctLock, slotOwner>>

Recover(b) ==
    /\ b \in crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \ {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<acctLock, slotOwner>>

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Banks : \E a \in Accounts : AcquireAcct(b, a)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : \E s \in Slots : AcquireSlot(b, s)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : \E s \in Slots : ReleaseSlot(b, s)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : \E a \in Accounts : ReleaseAcct(b, a)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Crash(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Recover(b)

SlotHoldsAccount ==
    \A s \in Slots : slotOwner[s] = Free \/ acctLock[Parent(s)] = slotOwner[s]

cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Banks = {bk1, bk2}
    Free = free
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT SlotHoldsAccount
nl:
A bank's interbank settlement engine allocates settlement slots using hierarchical locks. The ledger is divided into accounts, and each account contains several fine-grained settlement slots. A member bank must first take the coarse lock on an account, which is exclusive, and only then may it claim individual free slots inside that account; it releases slots and finally the account (an account can only be released once the bank holds none of its slots). Any single bank may crash silently at any time: a crashed bank simply stops taking actions, and because the crash is silent the locks it was holding remain held and are not reclaimed, which is safe though it may waste resources. A crashed bank can later be brought back online. The allocation discipline guarantees there is never a double allocation of a settlement slot to conflicting banks: any slot that is allocated is owned by exactly the bank that currently holds the coarse lock on that slot's parent account, and since account locks are exclusive, no two banks can ever hold slots in the same account.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every allocated settlement slot is owned by the bank that currently holds the coarse lock on that slot's parent account.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od5m9p0t3 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

VARIABLES epoch, inServer, assignEpoch

    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ inServer = {}
    /\ assignEpoch = 0

Assign(m) ==
    /\ inServer = {}
    /\ inServer' = {m}
    /\ assignEpoch' = epoch
    /\ UNCHANGED epoch

Leave(m) ==
    /\ m \in inServer
    /\ inServer' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, assignEpoch>>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ inServer' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED assignEpoch

Next ==
    \/ \E m \in Matches : Assign(m)
    \/ \E m \in Matches : Leave(m)
    \/ Reconfigure

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

MatchServerExclusive ==
    /\ (inServer = {} \/ \E m \in Matches : inServer = {m})
    /\ (inServer # {} => assignEpoch = epoch)

CONSTANTS
    Matches = {mA, mB}
    MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT MatchServerExclusive
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker assigns formed matches to a single dedicated game-server instance that can host only one live match at a time. The server pool is versioned by a configuration epoch. A match is assigned to the server only when the server is currently free, and the assignment is stamped with the current epoch; the match later leaves when the game ends, freeing the server. Periodically the operator performs an epoch-numbered reconfiguration that advances the epoch and reprovisions the server; any match that was live is evicted by the reconfiguration, so a stale assignment stamped with an older epoch can never remain on the server. Participants are never treated as failed: a slow lobby may take an arbitrarily long time to form or finish a match, but there is no timeout or crash handling, only genuine progress at its own pace. Across every interleaving of assignments, match completions, and reconfigurations, the game server hosts at most one match at a time, and any hosted match is stamped with the current epoch.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The game server hosts at most one match at a time, and any hosted match carries the current configuration epoch.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od3m7p6t5 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Banks, NoOne, Mod
VARIABLES owner, version, acted

vars == <<owner, version, acted>>

    /\ owner = NoOne
    /\ version = 0
    /\ acted = {}

CAS(b, expv) ==
    /\ expv = version
    /\ owner' = b
    /\ version' = (version + 1) % Mod
    /\ acted' = {}

Act(b) ==
    /\ owner = b
    /\ acted' = acted \cup {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, version>>

Release ==
    /\ owner # NoOne
    /\ owner' = NoOne
    /\ version' = (version + 1) % Mod
    /\ acted' = {}

AdminSeize(b) ==
    /\ owner' = b
    /\ version' = (version + 1) % Mod
    /\ acted' = {}

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Banks : \E expv \in 0 .. (Mod - 1) : CAS(b, expv)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Act(b)
    \/ Release
    \/ \E b \in Banks : AdminSeize(b)

cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Banks = {bk1, bk2}
    NoOne = noone
    Mod = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OnlyOwnerActs
nl:
A bank's interbank settlement batch is driven by a single controller elected through a compare-and-swap register that names the current controlling bank together with a version number. A bank becomes controller by a compare-and-swap: it presents the version it last observed, and the swap succeeds only if that matches the register's current version, at which point the register names the new controller and its version is bumped; a swap presenting a stale version fails and does nothing. Only the bank currently named in the register may perform settlement actions on the batch, and every action taken in the current controller epoch is remembered. When the controller releases the register, or when a new controller is swapped in, the set of remembered actors resets for the fresh epoch. The clearing house holds a privileged admin override that can forcibly install any bank as controller, bypassing the compare-and-swap and bumping the version. The essential integrity property is that no unauthorized or stale bank ever acts: every bank recorded as having acted in the current epoch is exactly the bank currently named by the register.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every bank that has performed a settlement action in the current controller epoch is the bank currently named by the compare-and-swap register.

    /\ tripsCommitted = 0

    /\ lockStage' = 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<served, tripsCommitted, capacity>>

    /\ UNCHANGED <<served, tripsCommitted, capacity>>

    /\ lockStage' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED <<served, tripsCommitted, capacity>>

    /\ lockStage = 2
    /\ cl \notin served
    /\ served' = served \cup {cl}
    /\ tripsCommitted' = tripsCommitted + 1
    /\ lockStage' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED capacity

SetCapacity(c) ==

    /\ UNCHANGED <<lockStage, served, tripsCommitted>>

    \/ LockZone
    \/ LockCar
    \/ Abort

    \/ \E c \in 0 .. MaxCap : SetCapacity(c)

cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Calls = {c1, c2}
    MaxCap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleDispatch
nl:
A skyscraper elevator bank has a dispatcher that commits a trip for each hall call as an irreversible, one-shot action: once a call has been dispatched it must never be dispatched a second time. To commit a trip the dispatcher must acquire locks hierarchically, coarse before fine: first it takes the coarse lock on the elevator zone, and only then the fine lock on an actual car, which requires that at least one car is currently in service. Holding both locks, it commits the trip for a chosen still-pending call, which marks that call served, tallies one more committed trip, and releases both locks; the dispatcher may also abort and drop its locks without committing. The number of cars in service is reconfigurable at runtime as cars are taken out for maintenance or returned. The system tracks both the set of served calls and a running count of committed trips. Because a call can only be committed while still pending, these stay in lockstep: the running trip count always equals the number of distinct served calls, which certifies that no call's irreversible dispatch ever happens more than once.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The running count of committed trips always equals the number of distinct served calls, so no hall call is ever dispatched more than once.

spec_text:
--------------------------- MODULE W4Od12m2p2t0 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Sites, Total, NoTransfer
VARIABLES inv, escrow, transfer, crashed

vars == <<inv, escrow, transfer, crashed>>

RECURSIVE SumF(_)
SumF(S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN inv[x] + SumF(S \ {x})

SumInv == SumF(Sites)

Init ==
    /\ inv = [s \in Sites |-> IF s = CHOOSE z \in Sites : TRUE THEN Total ELSE 0]
    /\ escrow = 0
    /\ transfer = NoTransfer
    /\ crashed = {}

Prepare(s, t) ==
    /\ transfer = NoTransfer
    /\ s # t
    /\ s \notin crashed
    /\ inv[s] > 0
    /\ inv' = [inv EXCEPT ![s] = inv[s] - 1]
    /\ escrow' = 1
    /\ transfer' = [src |-> s, dst |-> t]
    /\ UNCHANGED crashed

Commit ==
    /\ transfer # NoTransfer
    /\ inv' = [inv EXCEPT ![transfer.dst] = inv[transfer.dst] + 1]
    /\ escrow' = 0
    /\ transfer' = NoTransfer
    /\ UNCHANGED crashed

Abort ==
    /\ transfer # NoTransfer
    /\ inv' = [inv EXCEPT ![transfer.src] = inv[transfer.src] + 1]
    /\ escrow' = 0
    /\ transfer' = NoTransfer
    /\ UNCHANGED crashed

Crash(s) ==
    /\ s \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inv, escrow, transfer>>

Recover(s) ==
    /\ s \in crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \ {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inv, escrow, transfer>>

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Sites : \E t \in Sites : Prepare(s, t)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort
    \/ \E s \in Sites : Crash(s)
    \/ \E s \in Sites : Recover(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

BloodConserved == SumInv + escrow = Total
=========================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Sites = {siteA, siteB}
    Total = 2
    NoTransfer = notransfer
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT BloodConserved
nl:
A blood-bank network tracks a fixed total number of blood units held across its storage sites, and moves units between sites using two-phase commit so that a unit is never lost or duplicated in transit. To transfer one unit, the coordinator prepares the move: it debits one unit from the source site and places it into an escrow that represents the in-flight unit reserved but not yet delivered. The transfer then either commits, crediting the unit to the destination site and emptying the escrow, or aborts, returning the escrowed unit to the source site. Only one transfer is in flight at a time. Any single site may crash silently at any moment; a crashed site simply stops initiating new transfers, and a unit already in escrow stays safely accounted for until the in-flight transfer resolves. A crashed site may later come back online. Because every step only moves a unit between a site and the escrow, the grand total is conserved: the sum of all site inventories plus the unit held in escrow always equals the fixed network total, so no blood unit is ever created or destroyed.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The sum of all site inventories plus the escrowed in-flight unit always equals the fixed network total of blood units.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od19m0p0t4 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Librarians, Mod, MaxCap
VARIABLES inCS, version, attempt, capacity

vars == <<inCS, version, attempt, capacity>>

NoAtt == Mod

Init ==
    /\ inCS = {}
    /\ version = 0
    /\ attempt = [l \in Librarians |-> NoAtt]
    /\ capacity = MaxCap

Read(l) ==
    /\ attempt' = [attempt EXCEPT ![l] = version]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inCS, version, capacity>>

Enter(l) ==
    /\ attempt[l] = version
    /\ inCS = {}
    /\ inCS' = {l}
    /\ version' = (version + 1) % Mod
    /\ attempt' = [attempt EXCEPT ![l] = NoAtt]
    /\ UNCHANGED capacity

Retry(l) ==
    /\ attempt[l] # NoAtt
    /\ attempt[l] # version
    /\ attempt' = [attempt EXCEPT ![l] = NoAtt]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inCS, version, capacity>>

Leave(l) ==
    /\ l \in inCS
    /\ inCS' = {}
    /\ version' = (version + 1) % Mod
    /\ UNCHANGED <<attempt, capacity>>

SetCapacity(c) ==
    /\ capacity' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inCS, version, attempt>>

Next ==
    \/ \E l \in Librarians : Read(l)
    \/ \E l \in Librarians : Enter(l)
    \/ \E l \in Librarians : Retry(l)
    \/ \E l \in Librarians : Leave(l)
    \/ \E c \in 0 .. MaxCap : SetCapacity(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CatalogMutex == inCS = {} \/ \E l \in Librarians : inCS = {l}
=========================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Librarians = {lib1, lib2}
    Mod = 3
    MaxCap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CatalogMutex
nl:
A library reservation system lets librarians edit the shared reservation ledger, but the ledger's critical editing section may be occupied by only one librarian at a time. Entry is arbitrated with optimistic concurrency over a lock version number. A librarian first reads the current version, then attempts to enter the critical section; entry succeeds only if the version it read still matches the current version and the section is currently empty, at which point it enters and the version is bumped so that any other librarian's earlier read becomes stale. A librarian whose read has gone stale must abandon its attempt and retry with a fresh read. When a librarian leaves the critical section it bumps the version again. Separately, the reservation shelf capacity that librarians manage is reconfigurable at runtime and may be raised or lowered by staff at any time without affecting who holds the editing section. Across every interleaving of reads, entries, retries, exits, and capacity changes, the critical editing section is never occupied by more than one librarian at once.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At most one librarian occupies the ledger's critical editing section at any time.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od5m0p6t1 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Players, Mod
VARIABLES members, version, ready, pending

vars == <<members, version, ready, pending>>

Msgs == [player : Players, ver : 0 .. (Mod - 1)]

Init ==
    /\ members = Players
    /\ version = 0
    /\ ready = {}
    /\ pending = {}

Join(p) ==
    /\ p \notin members
    /\ members' = members \cup {p}
    /\ version' = (version + 1) % Mod
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ready, pending>>

Leave(p) ==
    /\ p \in members
    /\ members' = members \ {p}
    /\ ready' = ready \ {p}
    /\ version' = (version + 1) % Mod
    /\ UNCHANGED pending

SendReady(p, v) ==
    /\ p \in members
    /\ [player |-> p, ver |-> v] \notin pending
    /\ pending' = pending \cup {[player |-> p, ver |-> v]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<members, version, ready>>

ApplyValid(m) ==
    /\ m \in pending
    /\ m.ver = version
    /\ m.player \in members
    /\ ready' = ready \cup {m.player}
    /\ pending' = pending \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<members, version>>

DropStale(m) ==
    /\ m \in pending
    /\ (m.ver # version \/ m.player \notin members)
    /\ pending' = pending \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<members, version, ready>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Players : Join(p)
    \/ \E p \in Players : Leave(p)
    \/ \E p \in Players : \E v \in 0 .. (Mod - 1) : SendReady(p, v)
    \/ \E m \in Msgs : ApplyValid(m)
    \/ \E m \in Msgs : DropStale(m)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoStaleReady == ready \subseteq members
=========================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Players = {pl1, pl2}
    Mod = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleReady
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker maintains a lobby whose membership is versioned by a lobby configuration number. Players in the lobby signal readiness, but readiness is applied under optimistic concurrency: a readiness message carries the lobby version the player observed, and because the network reorders messages these signals accumulate and are applied in any order. Whenever a player joins or leaves the lobby, the configuration version is bumped, which makes any readiness message carrying an older version stale. A readiness message is applied only if it is not stale (its version still matches the current lobby version) and its sender is still a current lobby member; otherwise the message is simply discarded and the player must retry with a fresh read. When a player leaves, it is removed from both the membership and the ready set. The integrity requirement is that no unauthorized or stale participant is ever recorded as ready: every player in the ready set must be a current lobby member.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every player recorded as ready is a current member of the lobby.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od6m7p3t4 ---------------------------
CONSTANTS Cars, Calls, Free, NoneC
VARIABLES carCall, callCar, active

vars == <<carCall, callCar, active>>

Init ==
    /\ carCall = [car \in Cars |-> Free]
    /\ callCar = [cl \in Calls |-> NoneC]
    /\ active = Cars

AllocateCAS(cl, car) ==
    /\ car \in active
    /\ carCall[car] = Free
    /\ callCar[cl] = NoneC
    /\ carCall' = [carCall EXCEPT ![car] = cl]
    /\ callCar' = [callCar EXCEPT ![cl] = car]
    /\ UNCHANGED active

Deallocate(cl) ==
    /\ callCar[cl] # NoneC
    /\ carCall' = [carCall EXCEPT ![callCar[cl]] = Free]
    /\ callCar' = [callCar EXCEPT ![cl] = NoneC]
    /\ UNCHANGED active

RemoveCar(car) ==
    /\ car \in active
    /\ active' = active \ {car}
    /\ carCall' = [carCall EXCEPT ![car] = Free]
    /\ callCar' = [cl \in Calls |-> IF callCar[cl] = car THEN NoneC ELSE callCar[cl]]

AddCar(car) ==
    /\ car \notin active
    /\ active' = active \cup {car}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<carCall, callCar>>

Next ==
    \/ \E cl \in Calls : \E car \in Cars : AllocateCAS(cl, car)
    \/ \E cl \in Calls : Deallocate(cl)
    \/ \E car \in Cars : RemoveCar(car)
    \/ \E car \in Cars : AddCar(car)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

AllocationConsistent ==
    \A cl \in Calls : callCar[cl] = NoneC \/ carCall[callCar[cl]] = cl
=========================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Cars = {carX, carY}
    Calls = {call1, call2}
    Free = free
    NoneC = nonec
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT AllocationConsistent
nl:
A skyscraper elevator bank allocates in-service cars to pending hall calls, and each car may serve only one call at a time. Allocation is done through a per-car compare-and-swap owner register: to allocate a car to a call, the dispatcher performs a compare-and-swap that succeeds only when the car's register is observed free, atomically naming that call as the car's owner while the call records which car it was given. A call is deallocated by clearing both the car's register and the call's record. The number of in-service cars changes at runtime: a car may be taken out of service for maintenance, which, if it was allocated, immediately clears its allocation so neither the car nor its call remains bound; and a car may be returned to service. The consistency requirement that rules out double allocation is that the two records always agree: whenever a call records that it holds a particular car, that car's owner register must name exactly that call, so a single car can never be bound to two different calls.
SAFETY PROPERTY: For every call that records holding a car, that car's compare-and-swap owner register names exactly that call, so no car is ever allocated to two different calls.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od13m8p2t5 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Operators, Slots, Total, Free
VARIABLES depot, stock, coarse, fine

vars == <<depot, stock, coarse, fine>>

RECURSIVE SumF(_)
SumF(S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN stock[x] + SumF(S \ {x})

SumStock == SumF(Slots)

Init ==
    /\ depot = Total
    /\ stock = [s \in Slots |-> 0]
    /\ coarse = Free
    /\ fine = Free

LockMachine(o) ==
    /\ coarse = Free
    /\ coarse' = o
    /\ UNCHANGED <<depot, stock, fine>>

LockSlot(o) ==
    /\ coarse = o
    /\ fine = Free
    /\ fine' = o
    /\ UNCHANGED <<depot, stock, coarse>>

UnlockSlot(o) ==
    /\ fine = o
    /\ fine' = Free
    /\ UNCHANGED <<depot, stock, coarse>>

UnlockMachine(o) ==
    /\ coarse = o
    /\ fine # o
    /\ coarse' = Free
    /\ UNCHANGED <<depot, stock, fine>>

Restock(o, s) ==
    /\ coarse = o
    /\ fine = o
    /\ depot > 0
    /\ depot' = depot - 1
    /\ stock' = [stock EXCEPT ![s] = stock[s] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine>>

Collect(o, s) ==
    /\ coarse = o
    /\ fine = o
    /\ stock[s] > 0
    /\ stock' = [stock EXCEPT ![s] = stock[s] - 1]
    /\ depot' = depot + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine>>

AdminDeposit(s) ==
    /\ depot > 0
    /\ depot' = depot - 1
    /\ stock' = [stock EXCEPT ![s] = stock[s] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine>>

AdminCollect(s) ==
    /\ stock[s] > 0
    /\ stock' = [stock EXCEPT ![s] = stock[s] - 1]
    /\ depot' = depot + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine>>

Next ==
    \/ \E o \in Operators : LockMachine(o)
    \/ \E o \in Operators : LockSlot(o)
    \/ \E o \in Operators : UnlockSlot(o)
    \/ \E o \in Operators : UnlockMachine(o)
    \/ \E o \in Operators : \E s \in Slots : Restock(o, s)
    \/ \E o \in Operators : \E s \in Slots : Collect(o, s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : AdminDeposit(s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : AdminCollect(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

UnitsConserved == depot + SumStock = Total
=========================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Operators = {op1, op2}
    Slots = {s1, s2}
    Total = 2
    Free = free
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT UnitsConserved
nl:
A vending machine network holds a fixed total number of product units, split between a central depot and the machine's dispensing slots. Field operators redistribute units using hierarchical locks: to move a unit an operator must first take the coarse lock on the machine, and only then the fine lock on a specific slot; it releases the fine slot lock before the coarse machine lock. Holding both locks, an operator may restock, moving one unit from the depot into a slot, or collect, moving one unit from a slot back to the depot. The network operator has a privileged admin override that can move a unit between the depot and any slot directly, bypassing both locks, for remote emergency balancing. Every operation, whether locked or via the override, only relocates a unit between the depot and a slot; nothing is ever consumed, created, or destroyed. Consequently the grand total is conserved: the depot balance plus the sum of all slot contents always equals the fixed network total of product units.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The depot balance plus the sum of all slot contents always equals the fixed network total of product units.
